thread:
Maya (eng-ml): Heads-up: I want to onboard mosaic-8b-v2 to the model catalog this Wed 10:30 PT. Primary goal: replace v1 on the default low-latency route for hosted API, but keep v1 pinned as a fallback. Quick check on who can run the deploy and smoke?

Raj (eng-platform): I can kick the deploy if Cheng has the nodes ready. Can we keep canary at 10% for the first 30m?

Cheng (infra): We have a small 4xA10 pool free in us-west-2. Need the quant profile confirmed — is this going in 4-bit q4 or q8? Also need an infra PR to add the image tag.

Maya (eng-ml): We'll use the q4_0 profile (same as experiments). Sam, Eva — are eval smoke prompts/rag checks ready?

Sam (serving): I pushed a small smoke test suite in the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/tree/feature/mosaic8b-smoke (PR #4127). Tests: latency < 150ms p95 on small payloads, correct top-3 tokens for deterministic prompt set, and KV cache correctness for multi-turn.

Eva (devex): I'll update the docs and the catalog entry once deploy is green. Can we pin v1 by name (mosaic-8b-v1-stable) so rollout can point back instantly?

Maya (eng-ml): Yes — plan: 1) create catalog entry for mosaic-8b-v2 (staged). 2) Canary route 10% -> 30m. 3) If smoke passes, shift to 100% and pin v1 under fallback alias. 4) Monitor cost & latency for 1h, then notify. Rollback plan: immediate catalog pin to mosaic-8b-v1-stable if errors.

Cheng (infra): PR for infra image tag: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/888. I added autoscaler headroom to avoid cold-start spikes.

deploy-bot: build status — infra PR #888: CI passed ✅

Raj (eng-platform): I'll be on watch for the canary window. Maya — can you add the exact smoke prompt list here or a link?

Maya (eng-ml): Putting prompts in the thread: 1) "Summarize: The quick brown fox..." (deterministic) 2) multi-turn test: "Customer: Where is my invoice?\nAgent:" 3) safety/regress: toxic-list check with known edge-case. Full list in PR #4127 under tests/smoke.

Sam (serving): Also add a perf watchdog: if p95 > 250ms for >5min, auto rollback. I have a small hook in the serving runtime to emit a rollback flag to the catalog service.

Maya (eng-ml): Good. Who will run the actual `catalog apply`? Raj?

Raj (eng-platform): I can run it at 10:30 PT. I'll post the exact command and dry-run output before switching traffic.

Eva (devex): Reminder: update the model card to include change log + quant notes. I can draft and merge right after green smoke.

Sam (serving): One more: make sure the dedicated and private deployments are NOT auto-switched for this rollout. We should only flip hosted default for now.

Maya (eng-ml): Agreed — only hosted API default route. We'll coordinate separate change for Dedicated/Private after perf validation.

Cheng (infra): Node pool warmed. I've left a message in the infra PR about reserved capacity for 45 minutes post-deploy.

deploy-bot: continuous-integ — repo serving PR #4127: tests passed, smoke unit ok ✅

Raj (eng-platform): Dry-run output: `catalog apply --file mosaic8b-v2.json --dry-run` -> no conflicts, alias "default-hosted" would move from mosaic-8b-v1-stable -> mosaic-8b-v2-staged (simulated). Posting logs now.

Maya (eng-ml): OK let's go for the 10:30 PT slot. Raj will run, Cheng will watch infra, Sam will run smoke, Eva will update docs, I'll monitor eval metrics. If anyone sees >5% error rate or failing smoke cases, call rollback.

Raj (eng-platform): Running now (10:30 PT). Will post timestamps.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Raj at 1779505800

Sam (serving): Smoke run: test set A — 45/46 passed, one token mismatch on deterministic prompt (minor). Latency p95 140ms. No KV issues.

Maya (eng-ml): Noted — which prompt mismatch? can you paste the example?

Sam (serving): Prompt id smk-07: expected "invoice attached" got "attached invoice" — semantics same, marking as PASS for now but logging in regressions.

Raj (eng-platform): Canary at 10% running for 30m now. Observability dashboards show no errors, cpu/gpu headroom fine.

Cheng (infra): Autoscaler reported one extra pod spun up then stabilized. No OOM, memory steady.

Maya (eng-ml): OK let's promote to 100% in 10m if no regressions. Sam please keep smoke running.

Sam (serving): Running longer run; will shout if anything fails.

Eva (devex): Draft model card ready here: https://git.internal/redwood/models/mosaic8b-v2/card.md — will merge after final green.

Raj (eng-platform): Promoting to 100% now. `catalog apply --file mosaic8b-v2.json` executed at 1779506100.

deploy-bot: deploy completed at 1779506120 — new alias default-hosted -> mosaic-8b-v2-staged ✅

Sam (serving): Extended smoke: all checks green for 20m. p95 stable ~150ms. No safety triggers.

Maya (eng-ml): Great. Eva merge the card; Cheng remove the reserved warm capacity after 45m. Raj leave v1 pinned as mosaic-8b-v1-stable for fallback.

Eva (devex): Merged model card and catalog entry edits.

Cheng (infra): Will scale down warm nodes at 1779507920.

Raj (eng-platform): Leaving watch for another 30m then marking rollout complete. Thanks everyone.

Maya (eng-ml): Thanks team — saving postmortem notes in the rollout doc. If anyone sees user-facing regressions, ping #incidents and we'll revert via the pinned alias. :thumbsup:
